```{r create synthetic data, include=FALSE}
# https://www.r-bloggers.com/2016/02/generating-and-visualizing-multivariate-data-with-r/

library(MASS)

# Mean
mu_a_yg <- c(0,0,0)
mu_b_yg <- c(10,0,0)
mu_c_yg <- c(10,10,10)

mu_a_old <- c(5,0,10)
mu_b_old <- c(15,10,5)
mu_c_old <- c(15,0,5)
# Covariance matrix
sigma_a_yg <- matrix(c(1, .5, .5, .5, 1, .5, .5, .5, 1), 3)  
sigma_b_yg <- matrix(c(1, .25, .25, .25, 1, .25, .25, .25, 1), 3)  
sigma_c_yg <- matrix(c(1, .75, .75, .75, 1, .75, .75, .75, 1), 3)  

sigma_a_old <- matrix(c(1, .9, .9, .9, 1, .9, .9, .9, 1), 3)  
sigma_b_old <- matrix(c(1, .51, .51, .51, 1, .51, .51, .51, 1), 3)  
sigma_c_old <- matrix(c(1, .5, .5, .5, 1, .5, .5, .5, 1), 3)  

# Generate sample from N(mu, Sigma)
bivn_a_yg <- mvrnorm(2000, mu = mu_a_yg, Sigma = sigma_a_yg )
bivn_b_yg <- mvrnorm(1000, mu = mu_b_yg, Sigma = sigma_b_yg )
bivn_c_yg <- mvrnorm(2000, mu = mu_c_yg, Sigma = sigma_c_yg )

bivn_a_old <- mvrnorm(1500, mu = mu_a_old, Sigma = sigma_a_old )
bivn_b_old <- mvrnorm(2000, mu = mu_b_old, Sigma = sigma_b_old )
bivn_c_old <- mvrnorm(1000, mu = mu_c_old, Sigma = sigma_c_old )

# # Calculate kernel density estimate
# bivn_a_yg.kde <- kde2d(bivn_a_yg[,1], bivn_a_yg[,2], n = 50)   # from MASS package
# bivn_b_yg.kde <- kde2d(bivn_b_yg[,1], bivn_b_yg[,2], n = 50)   # from MASS package
# bivn_c_yg.kde <- kde2d(bivn_c_yg[,1], bivn_c_yg[,2], n = 50)   # from MASS package
# 
# bivn_a_old.kde <- kde2d(bivn_a_old[,1], bivn_a_old[,2], n = 50)   # from MASS package
# bivn_b_old.kde <- kde2d(bivn_b_old[,1], bivn_b_old[,2], n = 50)   # from MASS package
# bivn_c_old.kde <- kde2d(bivn_c_old[,1], bivn_c_old[,2], n = 50)   # from MASS package

# Contour plot overlayed on heat map image of results
# image(bivn.kde)       # from base graphics package
# contour(bivn.kde, add = TRUE)     # from base graphics package

y_a <- c(rep(0, 2000), rep(1, 1500))
y_b <- c(rep(0, 1000), rep(1, 2000))
y_c <- c(rep(0, 2000), rep(1, 1000))

x_a <- rbind(bivn_a_yg, bivn_a_old)
x_b <- rbind(bivn_b_yg, bivn_b_old)
x_c <- rbind(bivn_c_yg, bivn_c_old)

xdata <- scale(rbind(x_a, x_b, x_c))
ydata <- c(y_a, y_b, y_c)
ylabel <- c(rep("a",length(y_a)), rep("b",length(y_b)), rep("c", length(y_b)))

xdata_less <- xdata
```

# Classification modeling

Classification by sparse logistic regression.

```{r building weight vector for penalizing genes with smaller distance in correlation matrices}
# normalizing data
x_a_norm <- scale(x_a)
x_b_norm <- scale(x_b)
x_c_norm <- scale(x_c)

## correlation matrices

x_a_cor <- bigcor(x_a_norm, y = NULL, fun = "cor", size = 2000, verbose=FALSE)
x_a_cor <- as.data.frame(as.ffdf(x_a_cor))

x_b_cor <- bigcor(x_b_norm, y = NULL, fun = "cor", size = 2000, verbose=FALSE)
x_b_cor <- as.data.frame(as.ffdf(x_b_cor))

x_c_cor <- bigcor(x_c_norm, y = NULL, fun = "cor", size = 2000, verbose=FALSE)
x_c_cor <- as.data.frame(as.ffdf(x_c_cor))

# angular distance
ang_weight_mat = matrix(, nrow = 3, ncol = 3) #nrows is the number of combinations of the dataset groups in two slots

# matrix of correlation vectors here, between each combination of groups

# to penalize genes with smaller distances in the correlation matrix; try 1 - norm angle
for (i in 1:3){
  ang_weight_mat[1,i] <- 1 - acos(cosine(x_a_cor[,i],x_b_cor[,i]))/pi
  
  ang_weight_mat[2,i] <- 1 - acos(cosine(x_a_cor[,i],x_c_cor[,i]))/pi
  
  ang_weight_mat[3,i] <- 1 - acos(cosine(x_b_cor[,i],x_c_cor[,i]))/pi
}

hist(ang_weight_mat[,1])
hist(ang_weight_mat[,2])
hist(ang_weight_mat[,3])

ang_weight <- apply(ang_weight_mat, 2, mean) #what measurement of central tendency should we use is an open question
```

```{r fit glm with the penalties from correlation vectors}
fit_EN_cv_Late_oldyg <- cv.glmnet(x.lateMacs_norm, as.factor(y.lateMacs), family="binomial", nfolds=10, alpha=0.9, penalty.factor=ang_weight, type.measure="mse")

var_selected_EN_Late_oldyg_idx <- which(fit_EN_cv_Late_oldyg$glmnet.fit$beta[,which(fit_EN_cv_Late_oldyg$cvm == min(fit_EN_cv_Late_oldyg$cvm))] != 0)

var_selected_Late <- colnames(x.lateMacs_norm)[var_selected_EN_Late_oldyg_idx]

fit_EN_cv_Rep_oldyg <- cv.glmnet(x.repMacs_norm, as.factor(y.repMacs), family="binomial", nfolds=10, alpha=0.9, penalty.factor=ang_weight, type.measure="mse")

var_selected_EN_Rep_oldyg_idx <- which(fit_EN_cv_Rep_oldyg$glmnet.fit$beta[,which(fit_EN_cv_Rep_oldyg$cvm == min(fit_EN_cv_Rep_oldyg$cvm))] != 0)

var_selected_Rep <- colnames(x.repMacs_norm)[var_selected_EN_Rep_oldyg_idx]

venn.diagram(x = list(var_selected_Late, var_selected_Rep), 
             category.names = c("Late" , "Rep"),
             filename = 'twinner_venn_diagramm.png',
             output=TRUE)
```

```{r assess if identified features are differentially expressed with age in the macrophage populations}
features_lfc <- data.frame(genes = union(var_selected_Late, var_selected_Rep), late_lfc = NA, rep_lfc = NA)

late_age_deg <- read_excel('E:/Storage/bioinformatics/deg_results/immune_deg_mixed_annotation/old_v_young/all_aging_DEG.xlsx') %>% filter(cluster == 'lateMacs' & abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.2)

rep_age_deg <- read_excel('E:/Storage/bioinformatics/deg_results/immune_deg_mixed_annotation/old_v_young/all_aging_DEG.xlsx') %>% filter(cluster == 'repMacs' & abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.2)

for (i in 1:length(features_lfc$genes)) {
  feat <- features_lfc$genes[i]
  
  feat_late_idx <- which(late_age_deg$gene == feat)
  if (length(feat_late_idx) == 1) {
    features_lfc$late_lfc[i] <- late_age_deg$avg_log2FC[feat_late_idx]
  } else {
    features_lfc$late_lfc[i] <- 0
  }
  
  feat_rep_idx <- which(rep_age_deg$gene == feat)
  if (length(feat_rep_idx) == 1) {
    features_lfc$rep_lfc[i] <- rep_age_deg$avg_log2FC[feat_rep_idx]
  } else {
    features_lfc$rep_lfc[i] <- 0
  }
}

features_lfc <- features_lfc %>% 
  filter(late_lfc != 0 | rep_lfc != 0) %>%
  arrange(late_lfc)

order <- features_lfc$genes

features_lfc_long <- features_lfc %>%
  gather(key = "lfc", value = "value", 2:3)

ggplot(features_lfc_long, aes(x = lfc, y = factor(genes, levels = order), fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#075AFF",
                       mid = "#FFFFCC",
                       high = "#FF0000")
```

```{r evaluate classifier performance}
itrain <- sort(sample(nrow(xdata_less), nrow(xdata_less)*.9))

fit_EN_cv_oldyg <- cv.glmnet(xdata_less[itrain,], as.factor(ydata[itrain]), family="binomial", nfolds=10, alpha=0.9, penalty.factor=ang_weight, type.measure="mse")

var_selected_idx <- which(fit_EN_cv_oldyg$glmnet.fit$beta[,which(fit_EN_cv_oldyg$cvm == min(fit_EN_cv_oldyg$cvm))] != 0)

var_selected <- colnames(xdata_less)[var_selected_idx]

print("Evaluate classifier on training data")
assess.glmnet(fit_EN_cv_oldyg, newx = xdata_less[itrain, ], newy = as.factor(ydata[itrain]))

cnf <- confusion.glmnet(fit_EN_cv_oldyg, newx = xdata_less[itrain, ], newy = as.factor(ydata[itrain]))
print(cnf)

cfit_train <- cv.glmnet(xdata_less[itrain,], as.factor(ydata[itrain]), family = "binomial", nfolds=10, alpha=0.9, penalty.factor=ang_weight, type.measure = "auc", keep = TRUE)
rocs <- roc.glmnet(cfit_train$fit.preval, newy = as.factor(ydata[itrain]))
best <- cfit_train$index["min",]
plot(rocs[[best]], type = "l")
invisible(sapply(rocs, lines, col="grey"))
lines(rocs[[best]], lwd = 2,col = "red")

print("Evaluate classifier on test data")
assess.glmnet(fit_EN_cv_oldyg, newx = xdata_less[-itrain, ], newy = as.factor(ydata[-itrain]))

cnf <- confusion.glmnet(fit_EN_cv_oldyg, newx = xdata_less[-itrain, ], newy = as.factor(ydata[-itrain]))
print(cnf)

cfit_test <- cv.glmnet(xdata_less[-itrain,], as.factor(ydata[-itrain]), family = "binomial", nfolds=10, alpha=0.9, penalty.factor=ang_weight, type.measure = "auc", keep = TRUE)
rocs <- roc.glmnet(cfit_test$fit.preval, newy = as.factor(ydata[-itrain]))
best <- cfit_test$index["min",]
plot(rocs[[best]], type = "l")
invisible(sapply(rocs, lines, col="grey"))
lines(rocs[[best]], lwd = 2,col = "red")
```
